meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE after completing any significant implementation work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查代码、目标、安全与质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次实现后都需要多维度自动审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review code, goals, security, and quality in parallel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-dimensional automated review after every implementation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你完成重要开发工作后，自动启动 5 个后台子代理并行审查：验证目标与约束、检查代码质量、审计安全性、执行实际测试、挖掘上下文。所有代理必须全部通过，审查才算通过。
howto.when: 当你完成任何重要的实现工作后，说出“review work”、“review my work”、“review changes”、“QA my work”、“verify implementation”、“check my work”、“validate changes”或“post-implementation review”等触发词时。

say.note: 启动 5 个代理并行审查你最近完成的实现。
触发审查，检查实现是否满足原始目标和约束。
对当前代码变更进行全面的质量、安全与功能审查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will launch 5 parallel background sub-agents to review your completed implementation: verify goals/constraints, code quality, security, hands-on QA, and context mining. All must pass for the review to pass.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', or 'post-implementation review' after completing significant implementation work.

say_en.note: Launches 5 parallel agents to review your recent implementation.
